pages.title: Twelve floors · 1/3
paragraphs: It is eight o’clock on a Monday morning in New York. Gil waits in the lobby with a cup of coffee. The elevator opens with a soft sound. A woman with a small bag stands inside. Her name is Ruth and she lives on the ninth floor. She presses a button and smiles.
“Good morning! Which floor?” says Ruth. “Good morning. I’m on the twelfth floor.” says Gil. “Oh, I’m on the ninth. We are almost there.” says Ruth.

pages.title: Twelve floors · 3/3
paragraphs: “I’m going to visit my sister in Boston.” says Gil. “How nice! Have a great day. This is my floor.” says Ruth. Ruth gets off at the ninth floor and waves. Gil rides alone to the twelfth floor. In his apartment, he puts the umbrella by the door. At lunch, the sky turns gray and it rains. He takes the umbrella and walks to the cafe. A short chat can make the whole day warmer.
